subject: Next steps: demo + load profile for dedicated sizing

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: demo + load profile for dedicated sizing

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great coverage of your transaction mix and latency targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the sizing conversation: 

Summary (recap)
- Primary workload: real-time payments ingestion + fraud scoring on each request (avg request = 12 prompts, variable lengths).
- Peak SLA target: p95 token latency <= 250ms; sustained throughput target ~1,200 reqs/min during batch windows.
- Data locality: production sits in us-west-2, and you'll need a VPC/private deployment for PCI scope.

Immediate ask / next meeting
- Dedicated sizing call (technical deep dive) to review: representative load profile, request size distribution, and expected concurrency. We’ll bring Solutions Engineering and SRE to map to a GPU pool/quantization profile.
- Estimated time: 60 minutes.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Thu Apr 20, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Apr 20, 15:00–16:00
- Fri Apr 21, 09:00–10:00

Please confirm which slot works for you or send an alternate time. If helpful, attach a short sample of your anonymized request histogram (tokens per request + concurrency over 24h) — I’ve attached a checklist that shows the fields we typically need.

Attachments: novapay_workload_summary.xlsx (stub), redwood-dedicated-sizing-checklist.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: demo + load profile for dedicated sizing

Thanks Naomi — that recap is perfect.

We can do Thu Apr 20 at 15:00 PDT (that slot looks best for the infra and payments team). I’ll also attach a short export of our 24-hour request histogram (anonymized). Two clarifying notes before the call so Marcus & your SEs can prep: 

1) Encryption / key management: we use a customer-managed KMS and will need HSM-backed keys in the private deployment. Is that supported in the VPC package?
2) Model variants: we plan to run two variants (latency-optimized small quantized model for real-time scoring, and a higher-quality larger model for nightly re-ranks). Will the sizing call cover routing/fallback policies between those?

I attached the workload sheet (novapay_workload_summary.xlsx). If you need any other exports, ping me.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Director, Payments Platform | NovaPay
alex.rivera@novapay.com | +1 206-555-0188

Thanks — slot confirmed: Thu Apr 20, 15:00–16:00 PDT. I’ll invite SRE and our Private deployment SME.

Quick prep notes for the meeting (so we stay focused):
- Bring: sample histogram, representative prompt lengths (tokens), and concurrency curve across batch windows. The spreadsheet Alex attached looks good — I’ll pull the key columns.
- We’ll sketch two sizing scenarios: (A) single pooled cluster serving both model variants with autoscaling rules, (B) dedicated pools per variant with routing fallback. Each will have cost/latency tradeoffs.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via our VPC Private offering; Marcus will run through the integration steps and a short checklist.

Avery — can you take the first 10–15 minutes of the call to run a short demo of how fallback routing works in the console (kanban: policy attach -> test path)?

Regards,
